observations.text: The prepared worktree began clean at 63efa1f0e413740aa9184ac6d4301c98c414b044, detached, with the specified target commit present as its direct parent.
The target protocol SHA-256 is 2d23131cb104be50aeb163737e3cfbf10f5a9291acf7726c2eda75e3fa5e9b32 and matches the task config binding.

All tracking, lateral, yaw, and safety gate fields equal the sealed source protocol values; the threshold history shows the combination protocol was introduced after the baseline result and its SHA remained unchanged through the target.
Tracked baseline results show source_1, its exact repeat, and shared_adapter passed with the same trajectory digest; reset_only and model_only also passed their 1.0 m/s flat gates.
The two protocol cases use identical frozen conditions; combined_2 requires and repeats combined_1, with two attempts, no retry, and first-nonpass progression.
The campaign documents restrict interpretation to this pinned flat 1.0 m/s setup and disclaim low-speed, terrain, hardware, general-robustness, and causal claims.
The review result is the sole tracked change in commit c79d5db164241e38992d4ab00e91e57fba5f5b97; the detached worktree is clean.

inferences.text: Given the sealed source reference and individually passing adapter, shared-home, and shared-model evidence, the full pinned combination remains the smallest experiment that answers whether this deployment package preserves the established 1.0 m/s flat capability.

The repeat rule is coherent for a confirmatory campaign: a second case is run only after the first passes, an exact trace mismatch is an integrity stop, and a first non-pass stops without spending the remaining attempt on a known failed gate.
The prospective design does not select gates from a result of the new combination; it reuses the already sealed source gates and preserves explicit limits on what either verdict can establish.

conclusions.text: APPROVED: target HEAD bab5d56af48a23894c52982ad23b73f2a361e554 is scientifically suitable for the frozen formal campaign. No material prospective-design problem was found.

uncertainty.text: Two same-seed identical episodes test gate satisfaction and trace repeatability; they do not estimate success probability or robustness beyond the exact setup. This review evaluates the design and produces no campaign outcome.
